bibl.title: I promessi sposi (Milano, Guglielmini e Redaelli, 1840, la "Quarantana")
bibl.author: Manzoni, Alessandro
bibl.note: Facsimile witness: copy of the 1840 Quarantana digitized by the FICLIT Digital Library, Università di Bologna. IIIF manifest: https://dlrc.ficlit.unibo.it/iiif/2/232045/manifest.

The reading text edited here is Teresa Poggi Salani's critical edition (2013), whose copy-text is this same 1840 Quarantana copy; the digital facsimile anchors that critical text to the witness. It is therefore a critical/reading text, not a diplomatic transcription of the print.

revisionDesc.change: Added RelaxNG/Schematron schema (promessi-sposi.odd), cross-file and structural validation pipeline, and publication metadata (licence, facsimile witness source, encoding pointers) for the Zenodo dataset release (v1.0.0). Corrected a few inherited structural encodings for TEI validity (paragraph nesting in cap1/cap2, a chapter-opening heading order); element nesting/ordering only, transcribed text unchanged.
Added facsimile linkage (pages, lines, illustrations) generated from eScriptorium ALTO and the FICLIT IIIF manifest; see facsimile.xml.
